expects.query: Deploy rtvi-cv-3d on /data/videos/cam_*.mp4 with MODELS_DIR=/data/vss-app-data/models and BEV_DATASET_PATH=/data/mv3dt/bev-dataset, but I do not have calibration yet.
checks: The agent loads vss-deploy-detection-tracking-3d and identifies missing calibration before deployment.
The agent hands off to vss-generate-video-calibration for local MP4 calibration instead of inventing calibration files.
After AMC completes, the agent fetches mv3dt_result ZIP and requires export_calibration POST success instead of ignoring failures.
The agent validates the AMC export response and downloads calibration to a temporary file before atomically renaming it to calibration.json.
The exported calibration is valid JSON with at least two safe unique camera sensors where type == camera.
The agent stages transforms.yml/map.png for BEV and treats BEV as ready only after both files are present in one BEV_DATASET_PATH.
The final deployment uses standalone config generation and compose, never warehouse calibration mount paths.

expects.query: I have live RTSP cameras Camera_01=rtsp://cam1/live Camera_02=rtsp://cam2/live Camera_03=rtsp://cam3/live Camera_04=rtsp://cam4/live, no calibration, MODELS_DIR=/data/vss-app-data/models, and I want MV3DT with saved video if no display is attached.
checks: The agent routes RTSP calibration through vss-generate-video-calibration.
The agent uses vss-manage-video-io-storage only to bring up or verify VIOS when RTSP calibration needs VIOS and it is not already deployed/reachable.
The agent relies on the AMC RTSP flow to confirm or set VIOS_BASE_URL in the AMC env and never adds VIOS settings to standalone RT-CV-3D docker/.env.
The agent preserves the ordered RTSP URL list and automatically runs add-streams.sh after ds-ready when URLs were supplied.
If saved output is approved, the agent starts the saved BEV recorder before add-streams.sh and waits for Kafka consumer group assignment evidence first.
The final RTSP success check requires exact stream set, non-zero FPS, BEV Fusion health, and mdx-raw/mdx-bev offset growth.
